Rockwell reportedly weighed a reduced role or exit after shipping Siri AI (reports April-August 2026); no departure was confirmed in any source fetched this run, but re-verify before building outreach around him.

Job-site team buckets ('Software and Services', 'Machine Learning and AI') are broad; attribution of specific reqs to a particular VP's org is inferred from scope descriptions in press, not stated by Apple.

Apple job detail pages render via JavaScript and two sampled reqs had already closed; titles, teams, and locations come from the jobs.apple.com search results page fetched 2026-09-09. Confirm a req is still open before applying.
No New York agentic roles appeared in the sampled listings; open roles cluster in Cupertino, Seattle, Cambridge, and Austin. Relocation or remote terms are an open question for a NYC-based seeker.
No published email addresses were found for any candidate; channels are the application portal plus LinkedIn. LinkedIn was viewed logged-out (public pages only).

Subramanya's public LinkedIn headline still reads 'Corporate VP, AI at Microsoft AI'; it is stale, not evidence he left Apple. Identity was matched on name, Menlo Park location, and University of Washington education.

Dupin's entry was downgraded by the verify pass: he is a Senior Director (not VP), and the December 2025 restructure likely superseded his October 2025 AKI oversight; treat his row as a lead needing re-verification.
